title: Parameter-stable irreducibility, moving rows and global suspension frames

retained_primary_inputs.title: Quantitative properties of the non-properness set of a polynomial map
retained_primary_inputs.role: Explicit proof input: Definition 2.1, Proposition 2.2, Definition 2.3, and Theorem 3.2. For a generically finite polynomial map from complex affine space, its nonproperness set is covered by nonconstant polynomial images of A1. Only this qualitative conclusion is used, not the degree bound.

Explicit proof input: Lemma 15.113.3 multiplicativity of ramification indices, Definition 15.113.7 and the finite-etale criterion in the proof of Lemma 15.113.8. Only finite extensions of characteristic-zero divisorial DVRs are used.

Section 58.13, inertia definition, Lemmas 58.13.1-2, Example 58.13.3 and Lemma 58.13.4: inertia kernels describe the unramified quotient; for a regular base codimension-one inertia suffices by purity.
Retained closed-polynomial implication and the generative-field proof HC4MYIL0, used for the exact content-fibre criterion and multivariable transfer. No additional special-fibre theorem is imported.

newly_used_primary_inputs.title: Galois extensions and ramification: inertia restriction in a finite Galois tower
newly_used_primary_inputs.exact_import: Stacks Lemma 15.114.11, tag 0BU7: restriction in a tower with both extensions Galois maps the upper inertia group surjectively onto the lower inertia group.
newly_used_primary_inputs.portions_inspected: The complete lemma and proof in the primary 09E3 page, with the definition of decomposition and inertia groups. All tower hypotheses were checked for M E/F and M/F.
newly_used_primary_inputs.role: Lift every bad horizontal inertia group from M/F to M E/F before applying the original plane-source theorem. The lifted inertia fixes the parameter cover E(V)/F because that cover is finite etale at horizontal primes. This places the projected original inertia in the source image over L E.

direct_proof_arguments: horizontal bad inertia lifts to the parameter compositum and fixes the unramified parameter extension
the original source-image theorem puts the lifted inertia into the source subgroup over L E
the integral monic-model norm proof remains valid after enlarging its parameter field to contain an arbitrary E
the original bad-inertia block quotient therefore proves irreducibility after every finite parameter extension
a row-splitting parameter subgroup has transitive outer-root action and kills all moving class-lattice invariants
the coefficient content gives an exact height-one geometric-integrality criterion
either a monic multiplier leading term or a monic root leading term gives a global free filtration
a uniform polynomial presentation change supplies adapted global frames when both original leading coefficients are nonunits
a determinant-one Bezout parameter matrix gives the general multivariable adapted frame under an independent multiplier-content hypothesis
a strict joint degree gap admits arbitrary polynomial remainders and coefficientwise division gives a uniform univariate leading-divisibility corollary
